visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark brown hair and a wide, beaming smile stands centered in the frame. She wears a white halter-style bodysuit with a distinct teardrop cutout at the midriff, paired with black shorts and a white long-sleeved sweater tied around her waist. Her hands wave back and forth in a sweeping motion to the left and right. In the background, a diverse crowd of spectators in casual attire watches from stadium seating. The lighting is bright night artificial light from stadium floodlights. (2) She transitions into more dynamic arm movements, raising both arms high above her head with open palms and swaying her torso in a fluid, rhythmic motion. Her facial expression remains high-arousal with a constant smile and squinted eyes. The camera zooms in slightly, focusing on her upper body and facial reactions. The background displays green stadium seats and blurred figures of spectators, some of whom are clapping. (3) She extends both arms forward toward the lens in a welcoming gesture, then retracts them to clasp her hands over her chest. She tilts her head slightly to the left and executes a quick wink toward the camera. Her hair flows naturally and energetically with her physical movements. Behind her, a large banner with text and many fans in red and white jerseys are visible under the intense artificial lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music plays with a steady, driving synthesized drum beat and a fast tempo. A male voice leads a repetitive rhythmic chant in a high-arousal, professional cheering tone, which is echoed by the collective roar of a large crowd. The vocal delivery is sharp and loud, designed to sustain stadium energy. The acoustics suggest a large, open-air venue with minor reverb and no significant ambient noise besides the fans. (2) A new phase is triggered by a short electronic riser sound followed by two distinct percussive drum hits used for transition. The background music continues with a catchy synth melody overlaying the rhythmic bass. The crowd's cheering intensity surges, characterized by high-frequency white noise and rhythmic collective applause. The vocal lead continues his chant with increased volume and rapid delivery. (3) The music shifts slightly to a new melodic loop featuring a bouncy electronic bassline and bright synth textures. A brief structural pause in the main vocal chant is filled by a short, crisp electronic bell-like sound effect. The overall acoustic environment remains hyper-dense with high spectral brightness and strong percussive energy, maintaining a very high arousal level until the fade out.
